name: @lango-project/lango-client
description: A browser runtime for server-driven Lango UI applications.

scripts.build: lango build src/library.lango --out dist/library.mjs --target browser && lango build src/boot.lango --out dist/boot.mjs --target browser && lango run tools/assets.lango
scripts.test: npm run build && lango test src/test/core.lango --build-dir .test-output/core && lango test src/test/heartbeat.lango --build-dir .test-output/heartbeat && lango test src/test/field_values.lango --build-dir .test-output/field-values && lango test src/test/activities.lango --build-dir .test-output/activities && lango test src/test/widgets.lango --build-dir .test-output/widgets
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && lango run tools/browser.lango test
